title: Aggregate Palestine solidarity demonstrations, 29 November 2024 (105 events across 48 cities)
exclusion_reason: Do not code the reported aggregate as one mass-mobilization event: the report covers 105 distinct demonstrations across 48 cities but provides no venue-specific simultaneous attendance. The opened article also describes Gaza solidarity/condemnation of Israeli attacks without establishing a demand directed at Moroccan state policy. Individual sites remain unverified and cannot be split or thresholded from the aggregate.

start_date.summary: TRT says 105 demonstrations took place on Friday 29 November 2024.

location.summary: 48 cities, but no specific meeting-place or city-level attendance details are available in the reviewed lines.

organizer.summary: TRT identifies civil-society groups including the Commission marocaine pour la défense des causes de la nation.

demands.summary: The article states the slogan 'Stop the genocide in Gaza' and solidarity; it does not establish a Morocco-state-targeted demand.

participants_original.summary: Article mentions aggregate numbers of 105 demonstrations and 48 cities, but not participant counts per event.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No simultaneous attendance threshold for any individual location is established.
